text:
emma (Sales Ops): Heads-up: Borealis AI requested an off-cycle special pricing concession for May usage. They're asking for a 28% credit on a $45k overage and a one-time Net75 payment term. Ben looped us.
ben (Account Exec): Context: customer glitched a batch that drove evaluation runs. Overage = $45,000. They say cashflow crunch this month and asked Net75. Offering credit is to avoid churn — they're evaluating a multi-region Dedicated deal.
sam (RevOps): Uploaded usage logs and incident notes. Root cause was a misrouted test job. 28% = $12,600. Exposure if we accept both credit + Net75 = cashflow risk + DSO increase.
june (Finance): Rules: one-off credit > $10k requires Sr Finance approval. Payment term > Net60 needs manager approval + review of customer credit history. Also we prefer amortizing large concessions where possible.
emma (Sales Ops): Proposal: give a 25% one-time credit ($11,250) and temporary Net60 (not Net75), conditioned on a signed 9-month committed usage top-up. That keeps working capital tighter and ties concession to future revenue.
leah (Legal): I can draft a short amendment capturing concession, Net60 exception, and the 9-month commit. Include "one-time, non-precedent" clause. Need exact numbers to populate.
sam (RevOps): Action list: 1) Confirm concession amount 2) Legal amendment 3) NetSuite credit memo draft 4) Finance approval and posting after signed amendment. Created ticket BILL-4761 and attached calc.
june (Finance): I can approve up to $12k if we keep payment terms to Net60 and receive signed amendment before posting. If they insist on Net75 or >$12k, escalate to VP Finance.
ben (Account Exec): Customer agreed verbally to 25% + Net60 + 9-month commit. I'll get the amendment signed today. @sam please prepare NetSuite CM as pending-amendment.
deals-bot: Automated: Deal desk route triggered for thread 1805555555. Outstanding approvals: Legal amendment signoff, final Finance posting confirmation. Link: https://internal.redwood/desk/1805555555
june (Finance): :white_check_mark: Provisional approval for $11,250 concession pending signed amendment and NetSuite doc. Finance will post in current close once attached.
emma (Sales Ops): Thanks team. Closing criteria: signed amendment uploaded to BILL-4761 + NetSuite CM posted. Ben will drop the signed PDF here.
